headline: Brazilian Markets Tumble After Lula Re-Election Victory
summary: Brazilian equities and the real fell sharply following President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election victory, with the benchmark Ibovespa index dropping 10% and triggering a trading halt.
why: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy and a key global exporter of agricultural commodities, iron ore, and crude oil.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Unexpected political outcomes can spur risk aversion and capital outflows from national assets.

why_moved: Financial markets had priced in an opposing election result, prompting a sharp positioning unwind and sell-off upon the final count.
